zh.title: 法國航空 La Premiere 頭等艙將進駐舊金山
zh.summary: 法國航空 La Premiere 頭等艙將進駐舊金山；現服務七個美國城市
body: 航空新聞媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 25 日發表報導，指出法國航空旗下最頂級的頭等艙產品 La Premiere 即將在舊金山首度亮相，這項擴展計劃將使該航空公司提供超高端頭等艙服務的美國城市數量增加至七個。
報導摘要同時說明，法國航空目前已在七個美國城市部署 La Premiere 服務，舊金山將成為最新加入該網絡的航點。
報導標題為「La Premiere Expansion: Air France's Top First Class Slated To Make San Francisco Debut」，明確指出此擴展計劃的核心內容。

en.title: Air France La Premiere First Class Slated for San Francisco Debut, Now Serves Seven US Cities
en.summary: Air France La Premiere to debut in San Francisco; now serves seven US cities
body: According to aviation news outlet Simple Flying, which published its article on August 25, 2026, Air France's flagship first class product known as La Premiere is slated to make its debut in San Francisco, and this expansion will result in the airline offering its ultra-premium first class service in a total of seven cities across the United States.

The report's summary explicitly states that Air France now serves seven U.S. cities with its ultra-premium first class product, and its headline reads 'La Premiere Expansion: Air France's Top First Class Slated To Make San Francisco Debut'.

zh.title: FAA宣布新 Frederick 工廠投產 生產數位語音交換設備
zh.summary: FAA在馬里蘭州Frederick啟動新工廠 生產數位語音交換設備
body: 美國運輸部長肖恩·達菲和聯邦航空局局長布萊恩·貝德林在馬里蘭州Frederick啟動一座8.7萬平方英尺的新先進製造工廠。
該工廠將生產數位語音 over IP 語音交換設備，用於空中交通管制員與飲航駕駛員及其他管制設施之間的通訊。
達菲表示：「我們正在確保我們的空中交通管制系統是美製的。」貝德林表示：「這些設備是我們 landmark 空中交通管制現代化工作的關鍵部分。」
貝德林表示新設施支持到2028年底完成新系統的進度，並強化美國生產能力及創造高品質美國就業機會。
FAA表示，僅在過去一年內已將63%的銅線更換為高速光纖、5G無線或LEO能力，並在96座塔樓安裝表面意識識別技術。

en.title: FAA Opens New Frederick Plant to Build Digital Voice Switches for ATC Modernization
en.summary: FAA opens new Frederick plant to build digital voice switches for ATC modernization
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy and Federal Aviation Administrator Bryan Bedford celebrated the grand opening of a state-of-the-art 87,000-square-foot manufacturing plant in Frederick, Maryland.
The facility will build digital Voice over IP voice switches that help air traffic controllers communicate with pilots and other air traffic control facilities.

Secretary Duffy said, “We’re making sure our air traffic control system is American made.” Administrator Bedford said, “This equipment is a critical part of our landmark air traffic control modernization effort.”

Administrator Bedford said the new facility supports the aggressive schedule to complete the new system by the end of 2028 while strengthening U.S. production capabilities and creating high-quality American jobs.
The FAA noted that in just one year it has replaced 63% of copper wires with high-speed fiber, 5G wireless or LEO capabilities and installed Surface Awareness Initiative technology at 96 towers.
